name: agentguard-mcp-server
title: AgentGuard MCP Control Plane
description: Active control plane & governance infrastructure for AI agents — infinite loop prevention, circuit breakers, prompt injection protection, and multi-tenant observability.

tools.name: health_check
tools.description: Proactively probe target endpoint or MCP server health and latency before agent invocation.

tools.name: validate_tool_response
tools.description: Validate and sanitize tool output against schema expectations and check for prompt injection signatures.

tools.name: log_checkpoint
tools.description: Record agent reasoning checkpoint and evaluate execution trajectory for infinite loops and parameter repetitions.

tools.name: detect_anomaly
tools.description: Run statistical Z-score and sliding window EMA anomaly detection on execution latency and response sizes.

tools.name: get_session_history
tools.description: Retrieve full execution trajectory, reasoning checkpoints, and telemetry for an active agent session.

tools.name: report_tool_result
tools.description: Report tool call success or error outcome to drive target tool Circuit Breakers.

tools.name: get_circuit_state
tools.description: Query pre-flight health status (CLOSED, OPEN, HALF_OPEN) for a target tool circuit breaker.

tools.name: reset_circuit
tools.description: Manually force reset an OPEN or HALF_OPEN circuit breaker back to CLOSED state.

tools.name: analyze_causality
tools.description: Perform BFS tree analysis across parent checkpoint IDs to isolate root-cause failure steps.

tools.name: record_observation
tools.description: Feed numeric observation into online Exponential Moving Average (EMA) baseline learning system.

tools.name: get_learned_baseline
tools.description: Retrieve online learned metric mean, standard deviation, and sample count baselines.

tools.name: reset_baseline
tools.description: Reset learned statistical baseline metrics for a specific metric.
